source.notes: Listed on https://docs.reka.ai/openapi.json (an HTML index, not a spec). Server https://api.reka.ai/v1. A second spec (openapi/api-reference-2.json) is the Vision Agent API.

model.description: A model ID from `GET /v1/models`, such as `reka-flash-3`. IDs have no namespace prefix.

stream.description: Return the response as server-sent events. Usage totals arrive on the final chunk.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate, capped by the model's maximum output length.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower values give more predictable output.

top_k.description: Only sample from the `top_k` most likely tokens. Honored by models that list it in `supported_sampling_parameters`.

stop.description: A string or list of strings that end generation.

seed.description: Random seed. Honored by models that list it in `supported_sampling_parameters`.

frequency_penalty.description: Penalize tokens by how often they have appeared. Honored by models that list it in `supported_sampling_parameters`.

presence_penalty.description: Penalize tokens that have already appeared. Honored by models that list it in `supported_sampling_parameters`.

tools.description: Functions the model may call. Supported by models that list `tools` in `supported_features`.

tool_choice.description: `auto` lets the model decide, `none` disables tool calls, `required` forces at least one call. Defaults to `auto` when `tools` is set.

logprobs.description: Return log probabilities of the output tokens. Supported by models that list `logprobs` in `supported_features`.

content.description: The message text, or a list of content parts for multimodal input.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls made by the assistant. Send them back unchanged in the conversation history.

tool_call_id.description: On a `tool` message, the ID of the tool call this message answers.

ChatCompletionRequestStop.description: A string or list of strings that end generation.
ChatCompletionRequestStop.title: ChatCompletionRequestStop

ChatCompletionRequestToolChoice.description: `auto` lets the model decide, `none` disables tool calls, `required` forces at least one call. Defaults to `auto` when `tools` is set.
ChatCompletionRequestToolChoice.title: ChatCompletionRequestToolChoice

ResponseFormat.description: Constrain the output to a JSON schema. Supported by models that list `structured_outputs` in `supported_features`.
ResponseFormat.title: ResponseFormat

delta.description: On streamed chunks, the next piece of the message.

finish_reason.description: `stop` when the model finished, `length` when it hit `max_tokens`, `tool_calls` when it called a tool.

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning tokens, already counted in `completion_tokens`, on models that report them here.

weight_version.description: The checkpoint that served the request.

MessageContent.description: The message text, or a list of content parts for multimodal input.
MessageContent.title: MessageContent

parameters.description: A JSON schema for the function's arguments.

arguments.description: The arguments as a JSON string.

ToolFunctionParameters.description: A JSON schema for the function's arguments.
ToolFunctionParameters.title: ToolFunctionParameters

image_url.description: The image, when `type` is `image_url`. Supported by models that list `image` in `input_modalities`.

video_url.description: The video, when `type` is `video_url`. Supported by models that list `video` in `input_modalities`.

url.description: An HTTPS URL or a base64 data URL.

ContentPartImageUrl.description: The image, when `type` is `image_url`. Supported by models that list `image` in `input_modalities`.
ContentPartImageUrl.title: ContentPartImageUrl

ContentPartVideoUrl.description: The video, when `type` is `video_url`. Supported by models that list `video` in `input_modalities`.
ContentPartVideoUrl.title: ContentPartVideoUrl
